rows.label: Flat INT
rows.semantics: adds the main stat's flat-Attack channel (1 INT = 1 Attack, 1 LUK = 0.25 Attack, before ATTACK%) next to STAT_DAMAGE

rows.label: INT %
rows.semantics: adds the main stat's flat-Attack channel (1 INT = 1 Attack, 1 LUK = 0.25 Attack, before ATTACK%) next to STAT_DAMAGE

rows.label: LUK
rows.semantics: adds the main stat's flat-Attack channel (1 INT = 1 Attack, 1 LUK = 0.25 Attack, before ATTACK%) next to STAT_DAMAGE

rows.label: FINAL_DAMAGE % (multiplicative source)
rows.semantics: the +1% multiplicative step bumps the whole Final Damage bucket, including the live Final Flame Elemental / Burning Conduit share (Current / New include it)

rows.label: CRIT_RATE %
rows.semantics: Book of Ancient (if equipped): Crit Damage follows the crit-rate change

rows.label: ATTACK_SPEED % (diminishing returns, factor 150)
rows.semantics: Athena's Gloves (if equipped): Max Damage follows; Bottle of Emotion (if equipped): Final Damage follows

rows.label: Skill Level Bonus — 1st Job
rows.semantics: adds Fire Repulsion's (Attack %) level delta

rows.label: Skill Level Bonus — 2nd Job
rows.semantics: adds Word of Fire's (Attack Speed) and Spell Control's (Min Damage) level deltas

rows.label: Skill Level Bonus — 3rd Job
rows.semantics: adds Fires of Creation's (equipped Final Damage), Brilliant Enlightenment's (Min / Max Damage), Burning Focus' (Crit Rate / Crit Damage) and Liberated Magic's (Final Damage) level deltas

rows.label: Skill Level Bonus — 4th Job
rows.semantics: adds Phoenix Run's and Wild Blaze's (Final Damage), Flame Barrier's (Attack %) and Pure Magic's (Skill Damage, Max Damage) level deltas

rows.label: Skill Level Bonus — All Skills
rows.semantics: adds every passive's level delta (Fire Repulsion, Word of Fire, Spell Control, Fires of Creation, Brilliant Enlightenment, Burning Focus, Liberated Magic, Phoenix Run, Wild Blaze, Flame Barrier, Pure Magic)

rows.label: Skill Level Bonus — 2nd Job
rows.semantics: adds Word of Fire's (Attack Speed) and Spell Control's (Min Damage) level deltas

rows.label: Skill Level Bonus — 3rd Job
rows.semantics: adds Fires of Creation's (equipped Final Damage), Brilliant Enlightenment's (Min / Max Damage), Burning Focus' (Crit Rate / Crit Damage) and Liberated Magic's (Final Damage) level deltas

rows.label: Skill Level Bonus — 4th Job
rows.semantics: adds Phoenix Run's and Wild Blaze's (Final Damage), Flame Barrier's (Attack %) and Pure Magic's (Skill Damage, Max Damage) level deltas

rows.label: Skill Level Bonus — All Skills
rows.semantics: adds every passive's level delta (Fire Repulsion, Word of Fire, Spell Control, Fires of Creation, Brilliant Enlightenment, Burning Focus, Liberated Magic, Phoenix Run, Wild Blaze, Flame Barrier, Pure Magic)

cdr.note: step function in fixed-duration content (exact cast counts); fixed-duration content only
